time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t=0
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation first vs last frame shift (-0.01, 0.02) px; static-region mean abs diff to median < 1.7 grey levels
camera.view: fronto-parallel view of a building wall; wall plane faces the camera; horizontal floor/curb/road lines are horizontal in the image (no visible vanishing of horizontals); the hoop/backboard is a 3D prop seen slightly obliquely

objects.name: basketball
objects.distinguish: orange-red ball, the only ball; starts in the player's hands
objects.visible_frames: 0-93 and 96-130 (94-95 hidden inside the net; 81-93 lower part hidden by rim/net; 0-20 partly covered by hands)
objects.reference_point: circle-fit centre of the orange mask (= rigid ball origin)

objects.name: player
objects.distinguish: only person; basketball player in black jersey number 23 with light-blue trim, black shorts, white/blue shoes; face blurred grey; stands right of centre (x ~760-845)
objects.reference_point: pelvis estimate: shorts leg-hem trim row - 28 px (fallback foot line - 116 px); x = mean torso-mask x just below the waist; standing pelvis ~ (808.8, 695)

free fall from net to floor
first floor contact (ball bottom row 773, lowest centre y 758.9)
events.note: fall decelerates already from frame 117 (steps 13 -> 8.7 -> 7.2 -> 5.3 -> 0.8 px)

player feet raised off floor (foot bbox bottom < 805; floor line 811)
